Purpose ¶ This service implements a PrePublishDataset workflow step that sets DANS Data Vault metadata on the dataset-version about to be published. docs.text: Configuration ¶ This module can be configured by editing the configuration file. This file is installed in /etc/opt/dans.knaw.nl/dd-vault-metadata/config.yml when using the RPM. The settings are explained with comments in the file itself. An on-line version of the latest configuration file can be found here . Dataverse configuration ¶ To configure Dataverse to call this service, you must add it as an http/authext workflow step to the default PrePublishDataset workflow. The JSON to use in the step is included in INSTALL_DIR/install/workflow-step.json .

docs.text: Installation ¶ Currently, this project is built as an RPM package for RHEL8 and later. The RPM will install the binaries to /opt/dans.knaw.nl/dd-vault-metadata and the configuration files to /etc/opt/dans.knaw.nl/dd-vault-metadata . Building from source ¶ Prerequisites: Java 21 or higher Maven 3.8.7 or higher RPM Steps: git clone https://github.com/DANS-KNAW/dd-vault-metadata.git cd dd-vault-metadata mvn clean install
